Our Philosophy

Your Outdoor Space, Reimagined.

At Scope Landscaping, we believe a garden is more than grass and plants. It's an extension of your home — a space that should reflect your taste, complement your architecture, and invite you outside every single day.

"We specialise in design & implementing up-market gardens & outdoor upgrades on properties."

Based in George and serving the full Garden Route, we bring design thinking, horticultural expertise, and precision implementation to every project — from intimate courtyards to sweeping estate gardens.

What We Offer

Full-Scope Landscaping Services

From the first sketch to the final stone laid, we manage every detail of your outdoor transformation. No subcontracting. No shortcuts. Just beautifully executed gardens.

✏️

Garden Design

Professional design drawings, plant palettes, and 3D concepts that bring your vision to life before a single spade hits the ground.

🌿

Planting & Landscaping

Upmarket planting schemes using indigenous and exotic species, installed with care and long-term health in mind.

🪨

Hardscaping & Paving

Pathways, patios, retaining walls, and outdoor living areas — built with quality materials that age beautifully.

💧

Irrigation Systems

Water-smart irrigation design and installation. Your garden stays lush while you conserve every drop.

💡

Outdoor Lighting

Architectural and feature lighting that transforms your garden after dark into something truly spectacular.

🔧

Property Upgrades

Driveways, boundary walls, pool surrounds, fire pits, pergolas, and bespoke outdoor structures to complete your property.

How We Work

From Concept to Completion

Every Scope Landscaping project follows a proven process that keeps you informed and in control from day one — and delivers results that exceed expectations every time.

1

Site Consultation

We visit your property, listen to your vision, assess the space, and discuss your budget and timeline. No charge, no obligation.

2

Design & Proposal

We present a design concept with plant selection, layout drawings, and a detailed quote — so you know exactly what you're getting.

3

Implementation

Our team gets to work. We manage every element — plants, materials, contractors — with precision and care for your property.

4

Handover & Care

We walk you through your new garden, advise on maintenance, and remain available for any aftercare or follow-up work you need.
